item.title: Eight elephants killed after Rajdhani Express hits herd in Assam; Coaches derail
item.description: At least eight elephants were killed after the Sairang–New Delhi Rajdhani Express collided with a herd in Assam’s Hojai district early Saturday. The impact derailed the locomotive and five coaches, disrupting rail services across Northeast India. No passengers were injured.

item.title: Betting App Case: ED seizes assets linked to Urvashi Rautela, Sonu Sood, Yuvraj Singh, and others
item.description: Those whose assets have been attached include former Indian cricketers Yuvraj Singh and Robin Uthappa, actors Sonu Sood, Urvashi Rautela, Neha Sharma, Trinamool Congress former MP and actress Mimi Chakraborty, and Ankush Hazra.

item.title: Dhurandhar Box Office Day 15: Ranveer Singh film records strong collections, numbers surprise trade
item.description: With its powerful action, thrilling espionage sequences, and brilliant performances, Dhurandhar has successfully drawn audiences to theaters. Both fans and critics have praised the film extensively, making it one of the most talked-about films of 2025.

item.title: Veteran filmmaker Sreenivasan’s demise marks end of an era in Malayalam cinema
item.description: Veteran Malayalam actor, director, and screenwriter Sreenivasan passed away at 69 after a long-term illness. He acted in over 225 films, blending humor with social commentary, and directed award-winning films. A celebrated figure in Malayalam cinema, he also produced successful projects.

item.title: Maharashtra: Polling begins in 23 municipalities and municipal councils
item.description: Voting began on Saturday morning in 23 municipalities and municipal councils of Maharashtra. Voters are casting their ballots for the posts of president and members in these bodies, as well as for 143 vacant member positions. Voting started at 7:30 am and will continue until 5:30 pm.

item.title: Bangladesh on edge as Osman Hadi’s funeral set today; Full details inside
item.description: Bangladesh is on edge as student leader Osman Hadi’s funeral is scheduled this afternoon. Hadi was shot by masked assailants last week and later died in Singapore. His burial may take place near national poet Kazi Nazrul Islam’s grave. Protests have erupted nationwide, with attacks on media offices and government buildings.

item.title: PM Modi to address public rally in Bengal today; 1st visit to Matua stronghold amid NRC row
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Nadia district of West Bengal on Saturday. This will be the Prime Minister's first visit to the state since the draft of the National Register of Citizens (NRC) was published, and his third visit in the last five months.

item.title: Mobile recharge plans to get 20% costlier in 2026; Jio, Airtel, Vi to hike tariffs
item.description: In 2026, mobile recharge plans in India are set to become 16-20% more expensive. Telecom giants like Reliance Jio, Bharti Airtel, and Vodafone Idea plan to hike prepaid and postpaid tariffs. 5G users may face the highest impact, while mid-range plans of Vi will also see price increases.

item.title: James Cameron’s Avatar 3 opens strong but below Avatar 2; Avatar 4 and 5 confirmed
item.description: Avatar 3: Fire and Ash opened to ₹20 crore in India on day 1, less than Avatar 2’s ₹40.3 crore. The film’s release coincides with Dhurandhar’s strong box office run, which could affect its earnings. Starring Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldaña, Stephen Lang, and Kate Winslet, the film is directed by James Cameron.

item.title: AI Express suspends pilot over assault on passenger at Delhi airport; Inquiry ordered
item.description: Air India Express said that it was aware of the incident at the Delhi airport between one of its employees and a passenger. The employee was travelling as a passenger on another airline and indulged in an altercation with another passenger.
